text.headline: Timeline of Sweden
text.text: Major events in the history of Sweden.

events.headline: Unification of Sweden
events.text: The kingdom begins to take shape under early rulers like Eric the Victorious.

events.headline: Kalmar Union Formed
events.text: Sweden joins Denmark and Norway in the Kalmar Union under one monarch.

events.headline: Gustav Vasa Becomes King
events.text: Gustav Vasa leads Sweden’s independence from Denmark, founding the modern Swedish state.

events.headline: Sweden as a Great Power
events.text: Under Gustavus Adolphus, Sweden expands during the Thirty Years' War.

events.headline: Great Northern War Ends
events.text: Sweden loses territories to Russia, marking the end of its empire.

events.headline: Loss of Finland to Russia
events.text: Sweden cedes Finland to Russia after military defeat.

events.headline: Union with Norway
events.text: Sweden enters a union with Norway, which lasts until 1905.

events.headline: Norway Gains Independence
events.text: The union dissolves peacefully; Sweden continues as a constitutional monarchy.

events.headline: Neutral in World Wars
events.text: Sweden remains neutral, emerging economically strong.

events.headline: NATO Accession Process
events.text: After Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, Sweden applies to join NATO.
